title: Depot Maintenance Applications Consolidated 3 (Sources Sought)
description: Sources sought synopsis and request for information for Depot Maintenance Applications Consolidation (DMAC), issued Aug 10, 2026, for market research only. The Air Force is seeking responses from SBA 8(a) Business Development Program vendors registered under NAICS 541511 Custom Computer Programming Services. It is not a request for proposal and the government will not pay for response costs.
